original_test_intent: Validate the named Speed Change 45 operation by completing five hundred full-width Gen4-to-Gen5 PCIe transitions without link, endpoint, GPU, or system errors.
original_method: Resolve the label to the approved NVQual operation, verify the complete channel supports Gen5, and for each cycle establish full-width Gen4, request Gen5, capture equalization/LTSSM and settled full-width state plus error/health deltas, then admit the next cycle only after durable acceptance; stop and recover on first anomaly.
manual_activity: Owner/FAE defines Speed Change 45 and approves the Gen5 channel; lab personnel isolate the SUT and own console/physical recovery if high-generation training fails.
required_inputs: Authoritative Speed Change 45/NVQual command and configuration
Complete Gen5-capable PCIe path and target lane width
Per-cycle full-width Gen4 entry method and evidence
Gen5 request/equalization/LTSSM trajectory, settle timeout, transient and error rules
500-count, artifact-integrity, abort, final-state, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated approved SUT with stable power/cooling and out-of-band console
Do not guess a command from the label
Validate path, Gen4 start, and Gen5 capability
Stop on wrong start, equalization/retrain failure, late/reduced-width Gen5, new AER, endpoint/GPU/host loss, reset, thermal/power anomaly, or evidence gap
agent_execution_scope: Validate owner-supplied tool semantics, topology, capability, and criteria
Run only the pinned Speed Change 45 transaction
Persist Gen4 start, intermediate training, Gen5 settle, and error/health evidence per cycle
Stop before another cycle on ambiguity
Do not infer the command, accept lower width/rate, clear logs, retry, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve Speed Change 45 and complete Gen5 path
Set start, equalization, width, timing, error, and loop criteria
Review 500 results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its Gen4-to-Gen5 interpretation agrees with Criteria and Script, but the bare Procedure label and generic narrative do not define the executable Speed Change 45 recipe or complete acceptance contract.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the owner-pinned Speed Change 45/NVQual operation with atomic Gen4 start, Gen5 request/equalization, full-width settle, and error/health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Speed Change 45, LTSSM, 500 Gen4-to-Gen5 cycles, expected width/speed with no errors, no bundle, and 30/180-minute allocation remain.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve the label to a versioned primitive and use a fail-closed transaction ledger that proves both the Gen4 start and Gen5 full-width training outcome.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds executable semantics, path feasibility, per-cycle evidence, first-fault control, and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A generic high-speed loop or final Gen5 state cannot prove five hundred valid Gen4-to-Gen5 transitions under the named operation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Gen5 training can expose channel/equalization weakness, downtrain, generate AER, or remove/reset the GPU and host.

project_override_considerations: The Script field supplies acceptance language, not an executable command. Do not infer tool syntax or combine this row with Speed Change 35/16; a missing Gen4 start or reduced-width Gen5 result is not countable.
expected_evidence: Authoritative tool/configuration plus complete Gen5 path/lane identity
Raw monotonic 1-500 transaction records with timestamps and initial/intermediate/final states
First-fault recovery or clean final state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Joins the split Procedure/Criteria/Script semantics without guessing the vendor command and makes every Gen4-to-Gen5 transition traceable and fail closed.
independent_technical_reasoning: This row stores its operation across three fields: a vendor label, a Gen4-to-Gen5 repetition criterion, and a width/speed/no-error acceptance statement. Those establish intent but not how Speed Change 45 manipulates the link. A valid iteration needs direct proof of Gen4 entry followed by Gen5 equalization and full-width settle; otherwise an already-Gen5 link could be falsely counted. The higher-generation state and new-error delta must be committed before another cycle can erase the first marginal event.
